purpose: Host-only evidence audit; no inference, device operations, or private output text/tensor copying.
snapshot_policy: Filenames and SHA-256 values for all *.hf.private.json files in primary HF9 results were captured at cutoff. The six filenames observed are not six completed HF runs: five are completed references with TT comparisons; the requests10-cap4096-seed42 file is an active group-5 partial checkpoint and is excluded from completed-reference evidence until terminal completion and review.

tt_comparisons.logical_window_note: The JSON artifacts record continuation-relative forced row positions; per-layer physical cache slots/window maps are absent. Query positions and sliding logical window ranges above are derived from prompt length and the inspected runner contract.

chosen_tf_summary.window_coordinate_note: Reports persist continuation-relative row indices and conditioning token IDs, but no per-row cache/window-coordinate trace. Absolute logical query positions above are derived from saved prompt length and inspected runner contract; physical per-layer cache-window mappings are not directly verifiable from these JSON outputs.
chosen_tf_summary.index_semantics: Continuation row i predicts chosen token i. Query/input logical position is prompt_length - 1 + i. Sliding attention logical 1024-token inclusive window range is derived as [max(0, query_position-1023), query_position]; full-attention context starts at0. These are expected logical coordinates from the saved fixture and runner, not actual physical cache-row traces.

limitations: TT report selection was based on exact referenced fixture SHA and exact prompt_token_ids, never filename equality.
Per-row logical query input positions are derived from prompt length and inspected runner contract; compared artifacts do not store per-layer physical cache-window coordinates.
This audit verifies saved-artifact identity and alignment only; it does not rerun or verify the runtime comparison code.
scope_clarification: The six initial snapshot entries are six files observed, not six completed HF runs. Five completed HF result files contribute the ten audited TT comparisons. The Requests5414 call10 suffix4096 seed42 file is the active group-5 partial checkpoint for a 512-token generation cap; it contributes no completed reference or comparison yet. Its directory name records prompt suffix length, not generation cap.

active_incomplete_checkpoints.interpretation: The cap4096 directory component denotes the 4096-token exact prompt suffix; group 5 generation is capped at 512 tokens. The saved partial contains 64 teacher-forced positions and zero free-run results, consistent with the currently active group-5 checkpoint. It is not an incident artifact and must not be counted as a completed HF reference until the run is terminal and reviewed.

scope_amendment_history.correction: A prior amendment incorrectly described this partial file as an accidental runner-validation incident artifact. The current exact group-5 launch manifest and live PID command show it is the active suffix4096/512-output HF run checkpoint. The incident attribution is removed.
